feed.title: The Filing Desk
feed.subtitle: Company results, read from the SEC filings

entry.title: Marsh McLennan's revenue rose 8% to $6.9 billion as a legal settlement cut its margin
entry.summary: Revenue rose 8.1% to $6.9 billion and diluted EPS rose 11.9% to $1.69. A $144 million charge for the Greensill settlement cut the operating margin to 17.7%.

entry.title: Domino's net income rose 9.2% in the third quarter as U.S. same store sales grew 0.3%
entry.summary: Revenue grew 3.4% to $1.19 billion, mostly from supply chain sales and royalties from new stores. Net income rose 9.2% to $152 million, while U.S. same store sales grew 0.3%.

entry.title: Delta's revenue rose 21% to $20.2 billion as net income fell 47% on fuel and investments
entry.summary: Revenue rose 21.1% to $20.2 billion on higher fares and refinery sales. Fuel costs rose $1.8 billion and investments swung to a loss, so net income fell 46.6% to $756 million.

entry.title: Mortgage rates hit 7.40%, a short seller hit Lennar, and Berkshire bought $192.6 million more
entry.summary: A short seller says America's second-largest homebuilder leaned on its own spinoff to hit a sales target. Berkshire Hathaway kept buying anyway. What the filings show, and what it means for homebuyers.

entry.title: Costco's net income rose 13.9% to $9.2 billion as revenue grew 10.1%
entry.summary: Revenue grew 10.1% to $303.2 billion and net income rose 13.9% to $9.2 billion. Free cash flow reached $9.4 billion, and cash net of debt rose to $15.1 billion.

entry.title: A $2 trillion price tag, a model too risky to ship and insiders cashing out: is AI a bubble?
entry.summary: In one week, Anthropic's leaked IPO filing showed $518 billion of computing commitments, OpenAI shelved a model it judged unsafe, and Cerebras fell below its IPO price on the day its lockup ended. Here is what the money, and the filings, say.

entry.title: Nvidia revenue rises 65.5% to $215.9 billion as gross margin slips to 71.1%
entry.summary: Revenue grew 65.5% to $215.9 billion, led by Data Center sales of $193.7 billion. Gross margin fell 3.9 points to 71.1%, partly because of a $4.5 billion charge on H20 chips for China.

entry.title: Record profit at Microsoft, as data-center spending cuts free cash flow
entry.summary: Revenue grew 17.8% to $331.8 billion and operating margin hit 46.8%. Capital spending rose 80% to $115.9 billion, so free cash flow fell for a second year.
